definitions.achievedRequestsPerSecond: requests launched / configured durationSeconds; wallDurationMs includes draining outstanding requests
definitions.latency: GET launch to complete body or terminal error; all includes HTTP errors and timeouts; success includes only complete 2xx responses; nearest-rank percentiles
definitions.dropped: schedule slots skipped for concurrency or scheduler lag; excluded from request and success counts
definitions.upstreamAddr: raw X-Upstream-Addr response header, or null when absent
definitions.upstreamStatus: raw X-Upstream-Status response header; preserves multiple Nginx attempts even when final response succeeds; null when absent
